operator_visible_outcome: Action-policy tests and shell verification tests are split by cohesive intent without changing policy verdicts, family order or failure propagation

inputs.validation: Bounded tracked action-policy test, verification driver and verification-family inventory

outputs.validation: Deterministic split-inventory acceptance or rejection with a bounded diagnostic

canonical_state: Action-policy command execution and diagnostics are owned by main_test.go

Action inventory, alias resolution, structural bounds, document output, image inventory, permissions, YAML validation and fuzzing are owned by actions_test.go, aliases_test.go, bounds_test.go, document_test.go, images_test.go, permissions_test.go, yaml_test.go and fuzz_test.go respectively
The verification driver executes the lint, action, Rust configuration, Rust artefact, coverage, source policy, licence and release artefact families in that exact order
Every declared verification family is a tracked regular executable with Git mode 100755 while the shared fixture helper is not a family
Verification families execute serially and the driver records a family only after it returns success
The first missing, non-executable or failing family prevents later families from executing and makes the parent driver fail
Each family acquires its own unique temporary directory and the driver removes its execution record on every ordinary exit
derived_state: Focused action-policy, shell syntax, ShellCheck, family-inventory and independent Assurance verdicts

authorities.grant: Accept only the exact declared action-test and verification-family ownership inventories
authorities.refusal: Reject an old monolith, missing destination, undeclared sibling, wrong owner, reordered family or changed executable mode

authorities.grant: Execute the exact declared verification families serially in their declared order
authorities.refusal: Reject a missing, non-regular, non-executable or failing family without accepting partial execution

authorities.grant: Independently compare the exact test ownership, family order, modes and failure semantics
authorities.refusal: Reject changed policy coverage, order, mode, isolation, execution accounting or failure propagation

trust_boundaries.treatment: Compare the exact action-test and verification-family inventories with this manifest
Require the exact declared path and executable mode before direct serial execution
Compare Production inventory results with independent ownership, order, mode and failure fixtures

resources.acquisition: Read one bounded NUL-delimited tracked-file inventory
resources.bound: At most 100000 paths, 16777216 aggregate source bytes and 30000 milliseconds
resources.release: Release inventory and parsed syntax when policy evaluation returns
resources.cleanup_failure: Return an infrastructure error without accepting the tree

resources.acquisition: Start at most one declared family process at a time after validating its tracked executable mode
resources.bound: One parent driver and one active family with bounded family-owned child work
resources.release: Wait for the active family before selecting the next family
resources.cleanup_failure: Return failure and do not record the family as executed
resources.cancellation: Shell interruption stops the active driver path and cannot produce acceptance
resources.join: Direct family execution is joined before the ordered loop advances

resources.acquisition: Create one unique execution-record path through mktemp
resources.bound: At most eight newline-delimited declared family names
resources.release: Remove the execution record through the subshell EXIT trap
resources.cleanup_failure: Fail the surrounding verification environment without treating the record as maintained evidence

resources.acquisition: Read one bounded strict architecture policy document and its governed source inventory
resources.bound: At most 1048576 bytes per policy, inventory or fixture
resources.release: Release decoded policy and inventory when independent evaluation returns
resources.cleanup_failure: Return an assurance error without accepting the tree

success_semantics: Accepted means the exact action-test ownership and eight-family shell split preserve targets, order, executable modes, serial execution, labels, isolation, cleanup and failure propagation
refusal_semantics: An old monolith, missing destination, undeclared sibling, changed owner, missing or non-executable family, reordered inventory or weakened failure fixture returns a bounded rejection
failure_semantics: Malformed policy, parse failure, unavailable required tooling or any family failure fails the parent gate
cancellation_semantics: Cancellation stops the active policy or family path and cannot produce acceptance
indeterminate_semantics: Missing, contradictory or incomplete inventory or execution evidence cannot produce acceptance
recovery_semantics: Rerun from the unchanged tracked inventory after removing non-canonical temporary state; no partial family result is canonical
compatibility_or_reset_policy: Unused pre-release test layout is replaced directly; no old driver, wrapper, discovery path, forwarding script or duplicate test implementation is retained
falsifiers: An action-policy test or fuzz target disappears, duplicates or moves to an unrelated owner
The driver discovers families through a glob or executes them out of the declared order
A missing, non-regular, non-executable or failing family does not fail the parent gate
A family is recorded before it succeeds or a later family runs after failure
The split changes an output label, exit status, temporary isolation or Bash 3.2 compatibility
An old monolithic test implementation, wrapper or duplicate policy test remains

production_controls.owner: source-policy action-test inventory and focused action-policy tests
verification driver and testcheck family inventory fixtures
known-bad missing, mode and failure-propagation family fixtures
Bash syntax, ShellCheck, deterministic fixture and temporary-isolation controls

assurance_controls.owner: independent action-test ownership and target comparison
independent family order, mode and execution-accounting fixtures
independent parent-verdict and later-family non-execution fixtures
independent shell lifecycle and diagnostic contract comparison

residual_limitations: This structural split does not establish new workflow or verification behaviour
The manifest does not prove the correctness of external tools invoked by each family
Windows AMD64 remains the native Product and Assurance qualification boundary
Exact-pair sign-off requires committed clean Product and Assurance candidates
non_goals: Change action-policy parsing, permissions, image inventory or diagnostics
Add verification parallelism, caching, retries or dynamic family discovery
Change family order, labels, exit statuses, tool selection or policy semantics
Create a generic test runner, registry, plugin, wrapper or compatibility path
Move or split source policy, Product runtime, Rust worker or Assurance packages
Retain the old monolithic test bodies or duplicate an existing test target
deletion_criteria: Delete this slice contract only when a later reviewed contract explicitly supersedes the action-test and verification-family inventories
